description: Source-profile checks for StackAdapt retargeting, dynamic retargeting, lookalike, conversion and universal pixels. Checks route identifiers, optional args JSON, GET and the official server template headers when gtm_ss=1. Browser requests retain their own transport context. Custom properties and opaque account IDs remain open.

params.name: pixel_type
params.description: Route selected by the public template.

params.name: sid
params.description: The producer sends this configured identifier for the selected pixel route. No numeric or UUID grammar is imposed.

params.name: cid
params.description: The producer sends this configured identifier for the selected pixel route. No numeric or UUID grammar is imposed.

params.name: uid
params.description: The producer sends this configured identifier for the selected pixel route. No numeric or UUID grammar is imposed.

params.name: args
params.description: Optional JSON serialization of configured properties on non-retargeting transports.

params.name: gtm_ss
params.description: The pinned server template marks its requests with 1. Ordinary browser pixels may omit it.

params.name: ip_fwd
params.description: Optional source-profile IP address. Blank fallback values remain accepted.

params.name: url
params.description: Optional source-profile page URL. Blank fallback values remain accepted.
The public template serializes a property object. Additional members and their values remain open.

params.name: method
params.description: The pinned template sends GET. This advisory does not claim a server rejection policy.

params.name: query.gtm_ss
params.description: The server template marks the request with gtm_ss=1.

params.name: headers.x-forwarded-for
params.description: The official server template supplies this header. Blank IP and User-Agent fallbacks remain accepted.

params.name: headers.revision
params.description: The official server template supplies this header. Blank IP and User-Agent fallbacks remain accepted.

params.name: headers.user-agent
params.description: The official server template supplies this header. Blank IP and User-Agent fallbacks remain accepted.
